---
title: "Pivot between wide and long"
---

Turn a table with one sales column per year into one row per store and year,
then rebuild the wide table.

{{< include pages/_pivot.md >}}

- `pivot_longer()` stacks the columns that `starts_with('sales_')` selects.
  Each column name, without the `sales_` prefix, goes into `year`, and each
  value goes into `sales`. The other columns, here `store`, repeat for each
  stacked value.
- `year` holds strings, because the values come from column names.
- `pivot_wider()` makes one column for each value of `year`, adds the
  `sales_` prefix, and fills the columns from `sales`.
- The columns `pivot_wider()` doesn't use, here `store`, identify the output
  rows. Each distinct combination of them becomes one row.

Reference: [tidyr](../reference/tidyr.qmd#pivoting) ·
[tidyselect and across()](../reference/tidyselect.qmd#selectors)
